landing.subheadline: Halo gives nurses, patients, families, and review teams one place for messages, patient updates, and handoff notes.
landing.signInBlurb: Sign in with your email or phone. We'll set up your care role next.
landing.footer: Your care team controls access to private notes and patient reports.

onboarding.tellUsBlurb: We'll match you to the right care groups based on your role.
onboarding.patientFamilyQuestion: Are you the patient, or a family member?
onboarding.languageHint: We'll show Halo in this language.
onboarding.errorPickFamilyKind: Tell us whether you're the patient or a family member.
onboarding.errorNoEmail: We couldn't read an email. Link an email and try again.
onboarding.role_apsTagline: Adult or child welfare review, plus connected social services (PT, OT, social work).
onboarding.stateHint: We use this to apply the right state privacy laws to your account and to records you sign.
onboarding.errorPickState: Pick the state you're practicing or living in.
onboarding.npiHint: We verify this against the public NPPES registry before activating your nurse account.

dashboard.greetingBlurb: Review patient updates, catch up on chats, and add anything the next handoff needs.
dashboard.noReports: No patient reports yet. Add one from Care when something needs a handoff.
dashboard.noChats: No chats yet. Start one with a teammate or family contact.
dashboard.addPatientBody: Create a patient profile and connect the care team.
dashboard.postReportBody: Log pain, mood, appetite, notes, or handoff details.
dashboard.startChatBody: Message a patient, family member, or teammate.

recipientsPage.headerBlurb: Add patients, connect family, and keep each care team in one place.
recipientsPage.inviteListBlurb: Open a patient's chart to send an invite. The link is locked to that patient and the email you enter, so the invitee signs up into the right care team automatically.
recipientsPage.inviteListTip: Tip: you can also enter the patient's email when adding them — Halo will generate a sign-up link for the patient on the spot.
